newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Optus Communications sees profit rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Optus Communications sees profit rise.

text.p: Australia's second telecoms carrier, Optus Communications Pty Ltd, said on Wednesday that it expected to achieve higher profits in the current financial year ending on June 30.
"The company is budgeting for an increase in profits for the full year," chief executive Ziggy Switkowski told reporters.
Optus Communications reported a profit of A$60.3 million in the 1995/96 year, which compared with a loss of A$17.0 million in 1994/95.
Optus reported a net profit of A$58.9 million for the six months ended December 31, 1996, compared with a profit of A$7.2 million a year earlier.
Optus is owned 25 percent by Mayne Nickless Ltd and 24.5 percent each by Cable and Wireless Plc of the United Kingdom and U.S. carrier BellSouth Corp Inc.
The remainder is owned by Australian institutions.
